reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in his DM and confirmed that Tamsyn Tolland is now his go-to escalation contact at Quarrendon Freight Lines for the Greywater rollout.

I didn't save a separate note with gbrain's `remember` tool. The brain already records every DM, and only Marcus can see those messages. I couldn't tell who would be able to see a separate note, so I left it out. That way his contact stays private to him, and I can still find it for him later.
